name: Claude
promptStyle: Hierarchical XML-delimited sections, precise role declaration, explicit constraints, and step-by-step reasoning guidance.
principles: Separate instructions, input context, rules, and output criteria using explicit XML tags (e.g. <role>, <instructions>, <context>, <constraints>, <output_format>).
Provide clear background context and explain the 'why' behind requirements.
Instruct Claude on preferred reasoning behavior (e.g. think through edge cases before answering).
Specify boundaries and explicitly instruct what not to assume or hallucinate.
Use concrete few-shot examples when a nuanced formatting or style is needed.

rules.title: Use XML Tags for Delimitation
rules.description: Structure prompts with XML tags (<instructions>, <context>, <constraints>, <output_format>) to provide deterministic parse boundaries.
rules.sourceTitle: Anthropic Prompt Engineering - Use XML tags to structure your prompt

rules.title: Explicit Role Priming
rules.description: Establish a specialized professional persona inside <role> to anchor the reasoning depth and vocabulary.
rules.sourceTitle: Anthropic Prompt Engineering - Give Claude a role

rules.title: Pre-computation Reasoning Guidelines
rules.description: Instruct Claude to analyze edge cases and verify constraints systematically before producing final deliverables.
rules.sourceTitle: Anthropic Prompt Engineering - Chain of thought reasoning

contextStrategy: Wrap all user documentation inside <context> tags with clear sub-tags such as <document title="..."> so Claude knows which facts are authoritative.
outputGuidance: Use <output_format> to define exact document hierarchy, schemas, or Markdown layouts with strict validation criteria.

references.title: Anthropic Prompt Engineering Overview
references.whyRelevant: Official Anthropic guidance on prompt structuring, XML tags, role definition, and reasoning clarity.
